rows.question: Meri umar 35 saal hai, main kisan hoon, saal ki income 1.5 lakh hai. Mujhe kaunsi yojana milegi?
rows.answer:
Kisan Credit Card: Kisan ko kheti ke kharche ke liye bank se sasta loan milta hai. Apply karein apne najdiki bank branch se.
PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: Chhote aur seemant kisan ko saal mein 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein milte hain. Apply karein pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre se.
Atal Pension Yojana: 18-40 saal ke workers ko 60 saal ke baad monthly pension milti hai. Aap 35 saal ke hain aur income tax nahi bharta, isliye eligible. Apply karein kisi bhi bank ya post office mein form bharke.
Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Meri umar 40 saal hai, kisan hoon, income 2 lakh. Fasal kharab ho gayi, kya madad milegi?
rows.answer:
PM Fasal Bima Yojana: Fasal kharab hone par bima paisa milta hai. Apply karein pmfby.gov.in, bank, CSC centre ya bima company ke office se.
PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: Har saal 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein seedha bank account mein milte hain. Apply karein pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre se.
Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 45 saal ka kisan hoon, income 2 lakh. Kheti ke liye sasta loan chahiye.
rows.answer: Kisan Credit Card: KCC se aapko 7% tak ka byaaj aur 3 lakh tak ka short-term crop loan milta hai, revolving credit hai, baar-baar apply nahi karna padta. Apply karein apne najdiki bank branch se, pehchan patra, pata ka praman, zameen ya batai ke kagaz, photo, aur fasal ki jaankari ke saath. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Meri umar 25 hai, rehri lagata hoon, income 2 lakh. Loan milega?
rows.answer: PM SVANidhi: Street vendors ke liye bina guarantee ka working capital loan, pehla Rs 15,000, repayment par cashback aur credit card mil sakta hai. Apply pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in ya bank/CSC se. PM Mudra Yojana: Chhote vyapaar ya dukaan ke liye collateral free loan, Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories. Apply bank, NBFC ya MFI se business plan aur ID proof ke saath. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Meri umar 30 saal hai, chhoti dukaan chalata hoon, income 3 lakh. Business ke liye bina guarantee loan chahiye.
rows.answer: PM Mudra Yojana: Bina guarantee ke loan milta hai, 3 categories (Shishu, Kishor, Tarun) with different limits, apply at bank/NBFC/MFI with business plan and ID proof.

rows.question: Meri beti 5 saal ki hai, main 32 saal ka mazdoor hoon, income 1 lakh. Beti ke liye bachat yojana batao.
rows.answer: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana: Beti ki padhai aur shaadi ke liye bachat, 5 saal ki beti ke liye khula ja sakta hai, post office ya bank mein apply karein. PM Jan Dhan Yojana: Basic bank account, zero balance, free RuPay card, kisi bhi bank branch ya Bank Mitra mein apply karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 28 saal ka mazdoor hoon, income 1.2 lakh. Budhape ki pension yojana batao.
rows.answer: Atal Pension Yojana (APY): 28 saal ke mazdoor ke liye sahi yojana. 18 se 40 saal ke beech join kar sakte hain, 60 saal ke baad har mahine Rs 1000-5000 ki pension milti hai. 28 saal mein join karne par Rs 5000 pension ke liye lagbhag Rs 210 mahina lagta hai. Apply karne ke liye bank ya post office mein form bharke, Aadhaar, mobile number aur bank account ki jarurat hai. Income tax bharta hai to join nahi kar sakte. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 30 saal ka construction mazdoor hoon, income 1.5 lakh. Accident insurance milega?
rows.answer:
e-Shram Card: 18-59 saal ke mazdooron ko 2 lakh accident insurance milta hai, register karne ke liye eshram.gov.in par Aadhaar, mobile aur bank account se khud apply karein.
PM Jan Dhan Yojana: har parivaar ko bank khata milta hai jisme 2 lakh accident insurance hota hai, Jan Dhan khata kholne ke liye bank branch ya Bank Mitra se apply karein.

rows.question: Main 38 saal ka badhai (carpenter) hoon, income 1.8 lakh. Auzaar aur training ke liye koi yojana?
rows.answer: PM Vishwakarma Yojana: Ye aapke jaise carpenter ke liye training aur modern tools ka incentive deta hai, apply karne ke liye pmvishwakarma.gov.in ya apne nearest CSC centre se. PM Mudra Yojana: Chhote business ya dukaan ke liye bina guarantee loan milta hai, apply karne ke liye bank ya NBFC se business plan ke saath.

rows.question: Main 22 saal ka student hoon, SC category, parivaar ki income 2 lakh. Scholarship milegi?
rows.answer: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Scholarship: SC students with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh can get post‑matric scholarships (maintenance allowance & fee support). Apply by registering on scholarships.gov.in, fill the form for the scheme you choose, upload required documents (jaati proof, income proof, marksheet, Aadhaar, bank passbook).

rows.question: Meri umar 50 saal hai, mazdoor hoon, income 1 lakh. Muft ilaaj ke liye 5 lakh ka health cover chahiye.
rows.answer: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: 5 lakh free hospital treatment, apply by visiting CSC or empanelled hospital with Aadhaar or ration card.

rows.question: Main 34 saal ki mahila hoon, gharelu kaam karti hoon, ghar mein LPG cylinder nahi hai, income 1 lakh. Muft gas connection milega?
rows.answer: PM Ujjwala Yojana: Garib parivaar ki mahilaon ko muft LPG connection milta hai. Apply karne ke liye mahila ke naam par Aavedan karein, KYC, ration card aur Aadhaar ke saath najdiki LPG distributor ke paas jaayein.

rows.question: Meri umar 42 saal hai, kaccha ghar hai, mazdoor hoon, income 1.2 lakh. Pakka ghar banane mein madad chahiye.
rows.answer: PM Awas Yojana: Is scheme se aapko kaccha ghar pakka ghar mein badalne ke liye financial help milti hai. Aapko Aadhaar, income proof aur bank details submit karni hongi, phir online ya CSC centre se apply kar sakte hain.

rows.question: Main 29 saal ki SC mahila hoon, abhi ghar par kaam karti hoon, naya business shuru karna hai, income 2 lakh. 20 lakh ka loan chahiye.
rows.answer: Stand-Up India: SC mahila ke liye naya vyapaar shuru karne ke liye bank se Rs 10 lakh se Rs 1 crore tak ka loan milta hai. Apply karne ke liye apne bank branch ya standupmitra.in par jaake scheme ki details confirm karein, jaati praman, pehchan, project report aur bank ki maangi hui jaankari jama karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Meri umar 27 hai, mazdoor hoon, income 1 lakh. Mera bank account nahi hai, zero balance khata kaise khulega?
rows.answer: PM Jan Dhan Yojana: Zero balance account khol sakte hain, free RuPay debit card milta hai, apply Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence ya NREGA job card ya PAN. Bank branch ya Bank Mitra (Banking Correspondent) se khol sakte hain. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 33 saal ki mahila hoon, tailor hoon, income 1.5 lakh. Silai ke kaam ke liye koi yojana?
rows.answer: PM Vishwakarma Yojana: Tailor ke liye training, toolkit incentive, low-interest loan. Apply at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or nearest CSC centre after gram panchayat verification.

rows.question: Main 26 saal ka street vendor hoon, sabzi bechta hoon, income 1.5 lakh. Digital payment pe cashback ya byaaj subsidy milegi?
rows.answer: PM SVANidhi: Street vendors in cities can get working capital loans without guarantee. First loan Rs15,000, second Rs25,000, third Rs50,000. On timely repayment you get interest subsidy and up to Rs1,600 cashback on digital payments. Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through bank/CSC. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Bitcoin mein paisa kaise lagayein?
rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai

rows.question: Aaj ka mausam kaisa hai?
rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai

rows.question: Mujhe Mumbai se Delhi ki train ticket book karni hai.
rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai

rows.question: bhai meri umar 52 hai, kheti karta hu, 2 bigha zameen hai, income 1 lakh. kya sarkar se saal ka paisa milta hai?
rows.answer: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: Aapko har saal 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein milenge, bank account mein seedha transfer. Apply karein pmkisan.gov.in ya apne najdiki CSC centre par. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 36 saal ka kisan hoon, income 2 lakh. Barish se fasal barbad ho gayi, bima ka paisa kaise milega?
rows.answer: PM Fasal Bima Yojana: Fasal kharab hone par bima paisa milta hai. Barish se nuksaan claim karne ke liye aadhaar, bank account, zameen ya lease ka kagaz aur bowai ka praman jaruri hai. Apply pmfby.gov.in, bank, CSC centre ya bima company office se. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Meri umar 31 hai, gaay bhains paalta hoon, income 1.5 lakh. Dairy ke liye loan chahiye.
rows.answer:
Kisan Credit Card: KCC aapke gaay bhains palan ke kharche aur dairy equipment ke liye sasta aur jaldi loan deta hai, 7% tak ka byaaj aur revolving credit ki wajah se baar-baar apply karne ki zaroorat nahi. Apply karne ke liye apne najdiki bank branch mein pehchan patra, zameen ka kagaz, aur dairy ki jaankari lekar ja sakte hain.
PM Mudra Yojana: Mudra Yojana chhote dairy business ke liye bina guarantee loan provide karta hai, 10 lakh tak ki limit aur business plan ki madad se. Apply karne ke liye apne bank, NBFC ya MFI mein business plan aur ID proof ke saath aavedan karein.
Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 40 saal ka hoon, thela lagakar sabzi bechta hoon, income 1.2 lakh. Dhandha band ho gaya tha, chhota loan chahiye.
rows.answer:
PM SVANidhi: Street vendors ke liye bina guarantee ka working capital loan, Rs 15k se shuru, apply online (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) ya bank/CSC se.
PM Mudra Yojana: Chhote vyapaar ke liye bina guarantee loan, Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories, apply bank/NBFC/ MFI se business plan ke saath.

rows.question: Meri umar 35 hai, kirana dukaan hai, income 4 lakh. Dukaan badhane ke liye 5 lakh ka loan chahiye bina gaarantee.
rows.answer: PM Mudra Yojana: Small business loan up to ₹5 lakh without guarantee; apply through bank/NBFC/MFI with business plan and ID proof.

rows.question: Meri beti 8 saal ki hai. Main 38 saal ka driver hoon, income 2 lakh. Uski padhai aur shaadi ke liye bachat kaise karun?
rows.answer:
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana: Yeh scheme aapki beti ke liye hai jisme aap har saal 1.5 lakh tak jama kar sakte hain, interest 8.2% (2026 ke liye) tax‑free milta hai aur maturity par bhi tax‑free hota hai. Khata post office ya bank mein khol sakte hain aur har mahine thoda thoda jama karke padhai aur shaadi ke liye bachat kar sakte hain. 
National Scholarship Portal: Is portal par school aur college ke liye scholarships milti hain, jaise pre‑matric aur post‑matric scholarships. Aapko apni family ki income ke hisaab se eligibility check karni hogi, phir online registration (OTR) kar ke specific scholarship ke liye apply karna hoga. 
Apply karne se pehle official website par rules aur eligibility criteria check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 45 saal ka painter hoon (rangai ka kaam), income 1.8 lakh, koi pension nahi hai. Budhape ke liye kuch hai?
rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai

rows.question: Meri umar 33 hai, ghar ghar jaake safai ka kaam karti hoon, income 90 hazaar. Koi card hai jisse insurance mile?
rows.answer:
PM Jan Dhan Yojana: Free RuPay debit card with Rs 2 lakh accident insurance; apply by visiting any bank branch or Bank Mitra with Aadhaar, voter ID, etc.
e-Shram Card: For unorganised workers like you, gives Rs 2 lakh accident insurance under PMSBY; apply online at eshram.gov.in with Aadhaar, mobile, bank account.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: Health insurance up to Rs 5 lakh for hospital treatment; apply by visiting CSC or empanelled hospital with Aadhaar or ration card.

rows.question: Main 41 saal ka kumhar (matka banane wala) hoon, income 1 lakh. Sarkar se training aur toolkit milega?
rows.answer: PM Vishwakarma Yojana: Isme aapko 5-7 din ki basic training aur 15+ din ki advanced training milegi, saath hi Rs 15,000 ka toolkit incentive bhi milta hai. Apply karne ke liye pehle apne gram panchayat ya nagar nikay se verification karwayen, phir pmvishwakarma.gov.in par online apply karein ya nearest CSC centre jaakar form bhar dein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 19 saal ki OBC student hoon, college mein hoon, ghar ki income 1.5 lakh. Fees ke liye madad milegi?
rows.answer: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Scholarships: Yeh scheme OBC post-matric students ke liye maintenance allowance aur fees ki bharpai karta hai. Apply karne ke liye pehle One-Time Registration (OTR) karen, phir portal par scheme chun kar form bharen.

rows.question: Mere papa ko dil ki bimari hai, operation 3 lakh ka hai. Hum garib hain, income 80 hazaar. Kya sarkar kharcha degi?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.question: Main 37 saal ki vidhwa hoon, chulhe pe khana banati hoon, income 70 hazaar. Gas connection free mein milega?
rows.answer: PM Ujjwala Yojana: Garib parivaar ki mahilaon ko muft LPG connection milta hai. Aavedan mahila ke naam par hota hai, nazdiki LPG distributor ke paas. KYC, ration card aur Aadhaar chahiye. Apply karne ke liye apne najdiki LPG distributor ya online portal par jaakar form bhar sakte hain.

rows.question: Meri umar 48 hai, jhopdi mein rehta hoon, income 1 lakh. Sarkar ghar banane ke liye paise deti hai kya?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aap kya kaam karte hain (kisan, student, dukaandar, mazdoor, ...)?

rows.question: Main 32 saal ka ST category ka hoon, manufacturing unit lagana hai, income 3 lakh. 30 lakh ka loan chahiye.
rows.answer: Stand-Up India: SC/ST entrepreneurs ko manufacturing unit shuru karne ke liye 10 lakh se 1 crore tak ka loan milta hai, apply karne ke liye standupmitra.in ya bank branch. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Mera kisi bank mein khata nahi hai, main 24 saal ka mazdoor hoon, income 1 lakh. Sabse aasaan kaunsa khata khulwaun?
rows.answer: PM Jan Dhan Yojana: Khata zero balance se khulta hai, free RuPay debit card milta hai, 6 mahine baad overdraft mil sakta hai. Apply bank branch ya Bank Mitra me Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence ya NREGA job card se.

rows.question: Main 29 saal ka mochi hoon, income 1.1 lakh. Apna kaam badhane ke liye sarkari madad chahiye.
rows.answer:
PM Vishwakarma Yojana: a mochi can get free training, a Rs 15,000 toolkit, and low‑interest loans (Rs 1 lakh first, Rs 2 lakh second) to expand work.
Apply at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or through a CSC after gram panchayat verification.

PM Mudra Yojana: small business loan without guarantee, suitable for a shop owner.
Apply via a bank, NBFC or MFI with a business plan and ID proof.

PM SVANidhi: street vendors can get working‑capital loans (Rs 15,000, 25,000, 50,000) with low interest and cashback.
Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through a bank/CSC with a vending certificate.

rows.question: Meri umar 55 saal hai, kisan hoon, income 1 lakh. KCC card kaise banta hai?
rows.answer:
Kisan Credit Card: KCC se aapko kheti ke kharche ke liye bank se sasta aur jaldi loan milta hai, koi baar-baar aavedan nahi karna padta. Apply karne ke liye najdiki bank branch se pehchan patra, zameen ka kagaz, photo aur fasal ki jaankari lekar jao.
PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: PM-Kisan se aapko saal mein 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein milte hain, direct bank account mein transfer. Apply karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre se register karo, Aadhaar, bank account aur zameen ke records dikhana hoga.
Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Main 27 saal ki mahila hoon, beauty parlour khola hai, income 2 lakh. Loan chahiye.
rows.answer: PM Mudra Yojana: Aapke beauty parlour ke liye bina guarantee ke loan mil sakta hai. Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories mein se aapki zaroorat ke hisaab se limit choose kar sakte hain. Apply karne ke liye bank, NBFC ya MFI mein business plan aur ID proof submit karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: scholarship kaise milti hai? main 17 saal ki ST student hoon, 12th mein hoon, ghar ki income 1 lakh.
rows.answer: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Scholarships: Because you are a 17‑year‑old ST student with family income below Rs 2.5 lakh, you qualify for post‑matric scholarships. Apply by registering on the NSP website, selecting the appropriate scheme, filling the online form, and uploading required documents such as caste certificate, income proof, Aadhaar, bank passbook, and previous class marksheet.

rows.question: Main 60 saal ka kisan hoon, ek acre zameen hai, income 80 hazaar. Har saal 6000 milta hai kya? Kaise apply karun?
rows.answer: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: 6000 rupaye per year, teen kisto mein seedha bank account mein milte hain. Apply karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in par register karein ya apne najdiki CSC centre jaayein. Kisan Credit Card: kheti ke kharche aur saaman ke liye sasta aur jaldi loan milta hai. Apply karne ke liye apne najdiki bank branch se sampark karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: PM Mudra Yojana mein shishu, kishor aur tarun kya hota hai?
rows.answer: PM Mudra Yojana mein teen categories hain: Shishu (loan limit Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 2 lakh) aur Tarun (Rs 10 lakh). Ye categories chhote vyapaar ke liye hain. Apply karne ke liye bank, NBFC ya MFI se business plan aur ID proof ke saath aavedan karein.

rows.question: Sukanya Samriddhi account kahan khulta hai?
rows.answer: Sukanya Samriddhi account post office ya authorised bank mein khola ja sakta hai. Beti ke naam par mata-pita ya guardian khata kholte hain. Apply karne ke liye post office ya bank branch jao, beti ka janam praman, parents ka Aadhaar, aur address proof leke jaye. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Ayushman card kaise banta hai?
rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.question: SVANidhi loan ka pehla amount kitna hota hai?
rows.answer: Pehla amount Rs 15,000 hai. Apply pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in ya bank/CSC se.

rows.question: Atal Pension Yojana mein kitni pension milti hai?
rows.answer: Atal Pension Yojana mein aapko 60 saal ke baad har mahine Rs 1000 se leke Rs 5000 tak ki pension milti hai, jo aapke chune hue amount aur contribution par depend karti hai. Apply karne ke liye aap apne bank ya post office mein form bhar sakte hain. Aadhaar aur mobile number jaruri hai. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: PMFBY mein premium kitna lagta hai?
rows.answer: PMFBY mein premium kharif fasal ke liye 2%, rabi ke liye 1.5% aur bagwani/commercial fasal ke liye 5% hota hai. Apply karne ke liye pmfby.gov.in, bank, CSC centre ya bima company ke office se apply kar sakte hain. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: e-Shram card ke fayde kya hain?
rows.answer: e-Shram Card free pehchan patra hai asangathit kshetra ke mazdooron ke liye. Isse 12 digit UAN milta hai jo poore desh mein kaam aata hai. 18-59 saal ke registered mazdooron ko PMSBY ke tahat Rs 2 lakh ka accident insurance milta hai. Registration eshram.gov.in par Aadhaar, mobile number (Aadhaar se linked) aur bank account ke saath khud kar sakte ho, ya CSC centre par. Registration free hai. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aapki umar kitni hai?

rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aap kya kaam karte hain (kisan, student, dukaandar, mazdoor, ...)?

rows.answer: Kisan Credit Card: Kisan ko kheti ke kharche (beej, khaad, dawai, majdoori) ke liye sasta aur jaldi loan milta hai, apply karein apne najdiki bank branch se. PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi: Chhote kisan ko saal mein 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein milte hain, apply karein pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre se.

rows.answer: Aapke liye sahi yojana dhoondhne ke liye mujhe thodi jaankari chahiye. Bataiye, aap kya kaam karte hain (kisan, student, dukaandar, mazdoor, ...)?

rows.question: (multi-turn) construction mazdoor, 40 saal, 1.2 lakh
turns: Mujhe yojana batao jo mere liye ho, kaunsi yojana milegi?
rows.answer:
e-Shram Card: Construction workers in unorganized sector get free identity card, UAN, and accident insurance. Apply at eshram.gov.in with Aadhaar, mobile linked to Aadhaar, and bank account.

Atal Pension Yojana: Unorganized sector workers aged 18-40 can get a monthly pension after 60. Apply at any bank or post office by filling the form, with Aadhaar and mobile number.

PM Vishwakarma Yojana: For artisans like carpenters, blacksmiths, etc. Provides training, toolkit, and low‑interest loan. Apply at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or a CSC centre after verification.

rows.question: (multi-turn) SC student, 22 saal, 2 lakh
rows.answer:
National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Scholarships: Aapke jaise 22 saal ke student ke liye, jo 200,000 INR annual income hai, yeh scheme aapko tuition fees aur maintenance allowance de sakti hai. Apply karne ke liye pehle NSP par One-Time Registration karein, phir apni scheme chunke form bhar kar submit karein.

PM Jan Dhan Yojana: Agar aapke paas abhi bank account nahi hai, to yeh zero balance account aapko free RuPay card aur accident insurance ke saath milta hai. Apply karne ke liye kisi bhi bank branch ya Bank Mitra par jaakar Aadhaar aur ID proof dikhayein.

Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Mujhe home loan chahiye 50 lakh ka, kaunsa bank sabse sasta dega?
rows.answer: PM Awas Yojana: Ye scheme aapko 50 lakh ka home loan sasti rate par dene mein madad karegi. Apply karne ke liye aapko apna Aadhaar, income proof, bank details aur property documents ready rakhne honge. Online ya nearest bank branch mein visit karke application form fill karein, required documents submit karein, aur bank ke approval ka wait karein. Apply karne se pehle official site pe rules check kar lein.

rows.question: Mere khet mein kaunsa keeda laga hai, kaunsi dawai daalun?
rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai

rows.answer: mujhe pakki jaankari nahi hai
